title: Financial Portfolios by AI
author: zoetsekas
selftext:
Any thoughts on this pre-release equity portfolio portal?

https://dev.financial-portfolios.ai

comments.author: zoetsekas
comments.body: I have created this portal to publish equity portfolios that are straightforward to follow. They can be accessed with AI providers like ChatGPT and Claude and programmatically via API, more information will be published once the portal goes live. The dev portal https://dev.financial-portfolios.ai/ is just a preview, you use use a fake credit card number to access subscriber content,  use credit card number 4242.... repeatedly, a real active CC won't be charged.

replies.author: zoetsekas
replies.body: you could, but when you can outperform it why not?

replies.author: Key_Statistician9890
replies.body:
I can promise you that you don’t need to worry about such a problem … because you are not beating the market and your AI dashboard is BS. 

You think you are really getting 21% alpha ?

Folks would do unspeakable horrors to get 4% alpha, even if it cost them an arm and a leg. 

Even 1% alpha would be extraordinarily impressive for a retail investor. 

I know as a matter of fact you aren’t getting alpha … because you don’t even have the ability to compute alpha!

replies.author: zoetsekas
replies.body:
thank you for pointing the alpha out that's a miscalculation of my CAMP implementation.
I need that kind of feedback to clear up these misprints.

replies.body:

replies.body: thank you for your feedback, please bear in my this is a preview and not the production version. The portal only publishes portfolios to help your own research and analysis. Your constructive feedback is appreciated.
